name: CoDraw
description: A collaborative drawing benchmark combining language, perception, and action, where two agents communicate via natural language to reconstruct abstract scenes using clip art. It includes ~10K dialogs and ~138K messages, with protocols and metrics for evaluating grounded goal-driven communication.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in grounded dialogue and collaborative communication research, often used for studying language-guided visual task completion.
notes: Introduces a novel 'crosstalk' evaluation condition pairing independently trained agents; dataset supports research in grounded communication.
